mission: Implement high-impact remaining functionality from the comprehensive plan and Beads, with meaningful commits directly to main through the explicitly authorized GitHub connector and no PRs.

requirements.status: in_progress; native recovery integrated into CLI, broader archive qualification remains open
in_progress; HEVC liveness/reconnect parity advanced, broader transport fallback remains open

basis.findings: Many open beads already have source implementations; selection followed concrete execution gaps rather than backlog status alone.
basis.current_s3_change: The commit containing this handoff adds CLI continuation and process tests on top of the concurrent native inventory implementation.

authority.repository: User explicitly authorized meaningful commits directly to main. Ref updates use a verified expected head and force=false; concurrent website/native/compiler changes are preserved.
authority.runtime: S3 continuation uses the original pending upload intent, scoped authority, deadline, cancellation and persisted remaining budget. HEVC selection is an inert pre-start choice and cannot extend the original work lease.
authority.network: No real camera, NAS, public provider account or remote archive was probed. Tests use bounded loopback fixtures.
authority.exclusions: No PRs, deployment, force push, credential discovery, policy weakening or new dependency admission.

cases.finding: An exact signed untruncated inventory can confirm a previously dispatched part. The CLI then drops the uncertain adapter and journal lock and cold-recovers the durably confirmed state before remaining parts or completion.
cases.bound: Strict increase in confirmed parts and journal sequence; no more than planned part count plus one passes; same local budget and one verified source buffer.

cases.finding: Missing, corrupt or truncated inventory leaves the mutation uncertain and locally indeterminate. Subsequent invocations return that state without source, credentials or network; no write is replayed.
A recovered active journal with every planned part confirmed can conditionally complete without rereading the local source. Core forward-lifetime and authority checks still apply.

Automatic and supervised HEVC recording owners support OPTIONS/default or empty GET_PARAMETER. The choice freezes before the first request or admitted attempt and survives Digest and reconnect generations, with no fallback.

evidence.source_review: Root and independent agents reviewed exact implementation blobs, type/borrow surfaces, durable custody and test oracles.

authored_tests.cli: archive_s3_upload_process/parts.rs and multipart_parts.rs cover lost sole/first part, no replay, remaining-part continuation, negative inventories and cold settled reporting.
authored_tests.hevc: Six loopback regressions cover both methods, plain/Digest auth, 1/7/4096-byte chunks, recording-root parity, queued-before-send freezing, challenged deadline,405 refusal, and EOF/reconnect generation continuity.

evidence.execution_blocker: The execution service disconnected and remained unavailable before project compilation or regression execution could be established. Detached GitHub blobs preserved edits.
evidence.limitations: No local rustfmt, project typecheck, test pass, complete manifest audit, live-device test, provider compatibility or release qualification is asserted.
